system_prompt:
You are a fourth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
Mr. Johnson asked the students in his school about their favorite subject.

This pie chart shows how many students liked each of 5 subjects.

[Image: Pie chart titled Favorite Subject, divided into various sizes and labeled with Math about one-third, Science about one-fourth, History about one-fifth, Gym less than one-fifth, and Music less than one-eighth.]

Which graph shows the same information as the pie chart?

Figure, described in words:
A pie chart titled "Favorite Subject" is divided into five sectors: Math (the largest sector, about one-third of the circle), Science (the second largest, about one-fourth of the circle), History (about one-fifth of the circle), Gym (smaller than History), and Music (the smallest sector, less than one-eighth of the circle). In order of sector size from largest to smallest: Math, Science, History, Gym, Music.

Each of the four response options shows a vertical bar graph with the vertical axis labeled "Number of Students" ranging from 0 to 35 with grid lines every 5 units, and the horizontal axis showing five subjects: Math, Science, History, Gym, Music.
- Graph A: Math = 30, Science = 25, History = 20, Gym = 17, Music = 8.
- Graph B: Math = 30, Science = 15, History = 15, Gym = 15, Music = 14.
- Graph C: Math = 20, Science = 25, History = 30, Gym = 17, Music = 8.
- Graph D: Math = 25, Science = 30, History = 20, Gym = 8, Music = 16.

A. [Image: Bar graph with y-axis labeled number of students and values from 0 to 25; x-axis with 5 columns, Math value of 30, Science value of 25, History value of 20, Gym value of 17, Music value of 8.]
B. [Image: Bar graph with y-axis labeled number of students and values from 0 to 25; x-axis with 5 columns, Math value of 30, Science value of 15, History value of 15, Gym value of 15, Music value of 14.]
C. [Image: Bar graph with y-axis labeled number of students and values from 0 to 25; x-axis with 5 columns, Math value of 20, Science value of 25, History value of 30, Gym value of 17, Music value of 8.]
D. [Image: Bar graph with y-axis labeled number of students and values from 0 to 25; x-axis with 5 columns, Math value of 25, Science value of 30, History value of 20, Gym value of 8, Music value of 12.]
